item.title: EU AI Act Article 4: What Creator Agencies and Small Teams Owe
item.description:
If you run a solo AI-assisted content operation, EU AI Act compliance depends mostly on your own choices. If you add a freelancer, editor, or contractor to your team, this changes. Article 4’s AI literacy obligation extends to anyone who deals with the operation and use of AI systems on your behalf. Most agency owners do not know this rule exists.

Article 4: the obligation you already owe

Article 4 requires providers and deployers of AI systems to ensure “a sufficient level of AI literacy” among staff and other people who operate those systems on their behalf. (The Commission’s November 2025 Digital Omnibus proposal can soften this rule. The proposal changes the obligation from ensuring literacy to supporting the development of it, an “obligation of effort” rather than a guaranteed result. As of this writing, the EU has not adopted this change. The stricter “ensure” wording below still applies.) This scope is wider than most agency owners assume:
